gates.why: No genuine message in the frozen test split is ever marked red.
No genuine official advisory quoted from the news is marked red.
At most 1 in 1,000 legitimate SMS in a public dataset we never trained on is marked red.
At most 1 in 200 legitimate SMS is told "don't act".
At most 1 in 25 genuine test items is told "don't act".
No scam in the frozen test split is cleared.
No real scam quoted from the news is cleared.
At least 85% of test scams get a "don't act" warning, not only "check first".
At most 10% of phishing SMS in the open dataset are cleared (most are UK/US prize texts with no Indian rail to check).
Every red-team attack that is not a declared known miss is defended.
In the jury spot-check kit, no scam is cleared and no genuine item is marked red.
At least 90% of kit items get exactly the expected kind of answer.
